summary.en-US: Vertical tabs in the sidebar: search, pin, group, snooze and back up your tabs. Local-first, no tracking, free and open source.

description.en-US:
All your tabs in one fast, searchable vertical list, in Firefox's sidebar or its own window. Find anything
  • Fuzzy search over tabs, bookmarks, history and saved sessions
  • Type > to run commands from the keyboard
  • Every tab in every window, with window names
Stay organized
  • Staples: a grid of the pages you use all day
  • Pinned folders, child tabs and Firefox's own tab groups
  • Save sessions and window setups, and restore them later
  • Snooze a tab until tomorrow
  • Suspend idle tabs to save memory
Make it yours
  • Themes, density and layout you control
  • Custom CSS
Back up your setup
  • Full backups with optional encryption, on a schedule you choose
  • Save to Downloads, Nextcloud/WebDAV, S3-compatible storage or Dropbox
Private by design
  • No account, no analytics, no ads
  • Private windows stay separate
  • Free and open source (GPLv3)
A note on maturity Firefox support is newer and has had much less testing than the Chrome version, so there will be rough edges. Keep backups of anything you cannot afford to lose, and please report problems or send fixes on GitHub.

version.approval_notes: The source is attached as a ZIP and also at https://github.com/humdedum1/vertically-challenged. Build: Node.js 22, then `npm ci && npm run build:firefox`; the output in .output/firefox-mv3 is what was submitted. The JavaScript is minified by Vite (WXT). A build transform in wxt.config.ts replaces two innerHTML assignments in Svelte's runtime with DOMParser. Details: docs/store/AMO.md.
